summary: F&G Annuities & Life, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 16, 2026, announcing CEO Chris Blunt will retire from his CEO role effective June 30, 2026, to focus on his roles as a Director and CEO of subsidiary Peak Altitude Equity, LLC. President and CFO Conor Murphy will become CEO and President, with Michael Bailey appointed as CFO effective August 3, 2026, and Mark Wiltse as Interim CFO. The Board has a process to explore strategic alternatives for Peak Altitude. No deal terms or shareholder vote triggered; a routine succession albeit with a strategic review of a subsidiary.
